title: FBN Program Placement Schedule
content:
Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) places every enrollment in one of six programs — FBN Starter Program, FBN Core Program, FBN Growth Program, FBN Scale Program, FBN Premier Program and FBN Enterprise Program — by the units the seller has shipped through FBN over the trailing 90 days. This schedule states, per program, the placement threshold, the interval between program reviews and the selling plan statuses a seller must hold to enroll or to send inventory.

## Schedule

| Program | Minimum units shipped through FBN in the trailing 90 days | Months between program reviews | Selling plan statuses required to enroll or send inventory |
|---|---|---|---|
| FBN Starter Program | 0 | 3 | active, cancel scheduled |
| FBN Core Program | 1000 | 3 | active, cancel scheduled |
| FBN Growth Program | 5000 | 3 | active, cancel scheduled |
| FBN Scale Program | 20000 | 3 | active, cancel scheduled |
| FBN Premier Program | 75000 | 3 | active, cancel scheduled |
| FBN Enterprise Program | 250000 | 3 | active, cancel scheduled |

## Notes to the schedule

- The minimum is a whole number of units. A program's minimum is met when the units shipped through FBN over the trailing 90 days are at least that figure; the minimum of FBN Starter Program is 0 units, so it is met by any enrollment.
- The review interval is 3 months in every program.
- The required selling plan statuses are the same in every program: the seller's selling plan must stand active or cancel scheduled.

## Reading the thresholds (illustrative unit counts)

| Trailing 90-day units (hypothetical) | Highest program whose minimum is met |
|---|---|
| 999 | FBN Starter Program |
| 1000 | FBN Core Program |
| 4999 | FBN Core Program |
| 5000 | FBN Growth Program |
| 19999 | FBN Growth Program |
| 20000 | FBN Scale Program |
| 74999 | FBN Scale Program |
| 75000 | FBN Premier Program |
| 249999 | FBN Premier Program |
| 250000 | FBN Enterprise Program |
